name: Reconstruction Drift Detection Registry
purpose: Detect topology-language drift toward primitive ontology, full source recovery, or hidden unification assumptions.

drift_flags.definition: Language implying that bounded accessibility is equivalent to proving source-relation identity.
Treating reconstruction topology as a physical manifold or literal spacetime structure.
Assuming that accessibility relations are bidirectional or reversible without explicit proof.
Using topological alignment to justify QM/GR unification claims.
Suggesting that reconstruction eliminates the need for projection-domain distinctions.
Omission of embedded-observer constraints in reconstruction analysis.

automatic_review_triggers.condition: Claim states that recoverability level GOLD proves source truth.
Topology analysis removes mandatory neighborhood conflicts.
Analysis assumes metadata accessibility beyond embedded limits.
Reconstruction score is reported without loss-accounting reference.

governance_rules.rule: Drift detection is mandatory for all reconstruction-topology artifacts at C4+ levels.
Any CRITICAL flag triggers an immediate REJECT_ESCALATION result.

forbidden_claims: Drift detection restricts creative theoretical exploration.
Topological alignment proves the framework is 'real'.
Source identity can be 'reconstructed' if drift is low.
